install.banner.text: Add this to your home screen for quick access.
checkin.question: How are you feeling right now?
checkin.privacy: Nothing you share here is ever saved, recorded, or transmitted.
affirmation.stressed: You noticed something is off — that takes real awareness. Let's give your nervous system a moment to settle.
affirmation.anxious: Right here, right now, you are safe. Your breath is always with you. Let's use it together.
affirmation.sad: Sadness means something matters to you. It's okay to feel it. Let's breathe together — one moment at a time.
affirmation.overwhelmed: You don't have to solve everything right now. Right now, there is only this breath.
affirmation.tired: Rest is wisdom, not weakness. You've been carrying a lot. Let's give yourself a little grace.
affirmation.angry: Your feelings are valid. Let's create some space together — breathe, and let that energy move through you.
affirmation.default: You showed up. That matters. Let's breathe together.
box-breathing.title: Box Breathing
box-breathing.subtitle: 4-count breathing — activates your calm response
box-breathing.extended-exhale: Extended Exhale Mode — shifts to a 6-count exhale for a deeper calm effect
box-breathing.coaching: Try to breathe into your whole trunk — chest AND belly. Place one hand on your chest and one on your stomach to feel both expand.
install.modal.title: Add to Home Screen
install.modal.subtitle: BREATH works like a native app when installed on your phone. No app store needed.
install.modal.privacy: Your privacy is fully protected. Nothing you share is ever saved, recorded, or transmitted.
install.modal.iphone.title: iPhone / iPad (Safari)
install.modal.iphone.step2: Tap the Share icon at the bottom of the screen
install.modal.iphone.step3: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
install.modal.iphone.step4: Tap "Add" in the top right corner
install.modal.android.title: Android (Chrome)
install.modal.android.step2: Tap the three-dot menu (⋮) in the top right
install.modal.android.step3: Tap "Add to Home Screen" or "Install App"
terms.modal.title: Terms of Use
terms.modal.subtitle: Please read these terms before using BREATH.
terms.b1: BREATH is a personal wellness tool for breathing and stress management. It is not a medical service, mental health treatment, or clinical intervention. Nothing in this app constitutes medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
terms.h2: Not a Substitute for Professional Care
terms.b2: If you are experiencing a mental health crisis, please contact a qualified professional or call/text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline). This app is not a replacement for therapy, counseling, or any other professional care.
terms.b3: This app is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We make no guarantees about outcomes, availability, or fitness for any particular purpose.
privacy.modal.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.modal.subtitle: Your privacy is a core principle of BREATH — not an afterthought.
privacy.notice: We collect absolutely nothing. No account, no login, no tracking.
privacy.b1: BREATH does not collect, store, or transmit any personal information. Everything stays on your device.
privacy.b2: This app contains no analytics scripts, ad trackers, or third-party services of any kind. There is nothing here watching you.
